title: Archive and Gravity Revisited
author: Theo Reyes
blurb: Coral Fairweather, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
